lines.road.title: COAST RUN
lines.road.rash.lost: PLACED {n}: NOT IN THE TOP THREE
lines.road.duel.join: PLAYER 2: PRESS START ON A PAD (2 ON THE KEYBOARD)

notes.road.title: The driving game's title, on its menu: a run along a coast road.
notes.road.menu.car: Drive the coast run in a convertible car.
notes.road.menu.bike: Ride the coast run on a racing motorbike.
notes.road.menu.chase: A police chase after a getaway car.
notes.road.radio: Before the run: choose the car radio's song.
notes.road.radio.go: {key} is the key or button that starts the drive.
notes.road.song.breeze: A song's name on the radio (a light, sunny tune).
notes.road.song.sunset: A song's name on the radio (a slow evening tune).
notes.road.song.neon: A song's name on the radio (a fast night tune).
notes.road.stage.beach: A stage's name: a beach road under palm trees.
notes.road.stage.desert: A stage's name: a dusty desert road.
notes.road.stage.forest: A stage's name: a road through pine woods on a ridge.
notes.road.stage.canyon: A stage's name: a road through a red rock canyon at dusk.
notes.road.stage.city: A stage's name: city streets at night.
notes.road.stage.alps: A stage's name: a mountain pass in the snow at night.
notes.road.arch.check: Written across an arch over the road: a checkpoint that adds time.
notes.road.arch.goal: Written across the arch at the end of the run.
notes.road.arch.end: Written across the arch at the end of the chase's road: the getaway car escapes past it.
notes.road.fork: The road splits ahead: choose a side.
notes.road.close: The chase: the getaway car is in sight.
notes.road.arrest: The chase: the getaway car stopped, its driver caught.
notes.road.escaped: The chase failed: the getaway car escaped.
notes.road.timeup: The clock ran out before the goal.
notes.road.time: Over the clock at the top of the screen.
notes.road.rewinds: {key} is the key held to run time backwards; {n} rewinds are left.
notes.road.target: The chase: the getaway car is {m} metres ahead.
notes.road.nitro: The chase: {n} boosts of speed are left.
notes.action.nitro: A control's name, and its touch button: a burst of speed.
notes.action.rewind: A control's name, and its touch button: hold to run time backwards.
notes.road.menu.rash: A bike race against seven riders who fight: punch them, they punch back.
notes.road.arch.finish: Written across the arch at the end of the bike race.
notes.road.punch: A touch button: punch the rider beside you.
notes.road.rash.place: Your place in the race, {n}, of {of} riders.
notes.road.rash.punch: {key} is the key or button that punches the rider beside you.
notes.road.rash.down: A rider you punched has fallen off.
notes.road.rash.thrown: You were punched off your bike.
notes.road.rash.won: The race is over: you finished in place {n}, in the top three.
notes.road.rash.lost: The race is over: you finished in place {n}, outside the top three.
notes.road.menu.duel: Two players race each other on one road, the screen split in two.
notes.road.duel.join: Waiting for the second player: they press Start on a game pad, or 2 on the keyboard.
notes.road.duel.you: Which player's half of the screen this is.
notes.road.duel.ahead: How far ahead of the other player you are, {m} metres.
notes.road.duel.behind: How far behind the other player you are, {m} metres.
notes.road.duel.won: The duel is over: player {n} crossed the line first.
